props.mistake: Assuming all nail sizes sclea linearly with penny weight (e.g., 20d is 4 inches because 16d is 3.5 inches).
props.correction: Penny weight is non-linear and historically based on nail weight. Use ASTM F1667 reference tables; 20d common is 4 inches, but 10d is 3 inches, not 2.5 inches.
